auditor_jen: Hi team — for the upcoming SOC 2 fieldwork the auditor asks for our sampling criteria for RBAC changes and any documented exceptions for non-prod privileged access. What artifacts can you provide?

sara_sec: We can provide the change log export for the last 12 months, PR links for role changes, the RBAC approval matrix, and the exception workflow PDF.

auditor_jen: Great — for the sampling, they want to see how you pick which changes are included (random? risk-weighted?), and one example of an exception being approved + evidence.

sara_sec: We use a risk-weighted sampling: high-impact roles (cluster-admin, kms-admin, prod-deploy) are 100% sampled, medium roles are sampled at 25% and low at 5%. Criteria are in the control-mapping doc: s3://redwood-evidence/compliance/sampling/criteria.md

tomas_oncall: I can pull the Splunk query snippets for the RBAC change event stream and produce a CSV of matched events. Quick snippet: ```index=ops sourcetype=rbac_changes | table _time user role change_type pr_link```

devex_liam: PRs: #1124 (prod-role-restrict), #1188 (kms-delegate), #1210 (ci-service-account). I'll attach the approval thread links and the audit-log snapshots for those PRs.

auditor_jen: For the exception example please include the signed approval, evidence the change was scoped and timeboxed, and the rollback/playbook used.

sara_sec: Example ready: exception id EX-2025-07-03-08. Signed approval PDF at s3://redwood-evidence/compliance/exceptions/EX-2025-07-03-08-signed.pdf. Rollback playbook snippet (redacted): ```steps: - revoke-temporary-role - restore-binding-from-snapshot - notify-owners```

sec-bot: Automated export complete — evidence-bundle created at s3://redwood-evidence/compliance/bundles/7999999998-bundle.tar.gz (contains change log CSV, PR links, exception docs, and Splunk snapshots). :white_check_mark:

auditor_jen: Perfect. One follow-up — how do you tie KMS key usage to the RBAC changes? The auditor needs proof that key access didn't change unexpectedly during the exception window.

tomas_oncall: We correlate CloudTrail KMS:Decrypt/Encrypt events with the RBAC change window. I can produce a time-bounded export and a short mapping csv linking IAM principal -> KMS keyid -> cloudtrail_event_id.

sara_sec: Also capturing KMS key policy diffs and rotation events. If a key policy changed near the exception window we mark that as high-risk and include in the sample.

auditor_jen: Good. Last ask: please include the control mapping that links these artifacts to SOC 2 CC6 and CC7 (or ISO controls) so they can close the loop.

devex_liam: I'll update the control map spreadsheet to add the evidence bundle path and sample ids. Will ping here when done.

sara_sec: ETA ~2 hours. We'll deliver the bundle and a short README describing selection logic + queries used to generate exports.

auditor_jen: Thanks all — that should cover it. I may open a quick follow-up for one sampled item after review.

sec-bot: Reminder: evidence retention policy is 365 days for sampled artifacts; ask if longer needed. :information_source:
